qs.en: If the prosecutor asked, the inspector would investigate this mayor.

qs.en: You must investigate this incident before the end of the week.

qs.en: The commission was tasked with conducting an inquiry into the electoral irregularities.

qs.en: The polling institute plans to conduct a survey among one thousand participants about their political preferences.

qs.en: He is seventeen years old and has just started high school.

qs.s: Parmi tous les nombres, ___ dix-sept est son préféré.

qs.s: Il faut mémoriser ___ dix-sept avant de passer au suivant.
qs.en: You need to memorize the number seventeen before moving on to the next one.
